title: Physical Design Lead, Static Timing Analysis
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

In this role, you will drive Static Timing Analysis (STA) in the physical implementation of Application-specific integrated circuits (ASIC) using advanced technology nodes. You will lead timing margin derivation, constraint development and validation, and timing closure of large, complex high performance compute ASICs. You will develop static timing methodologies, margins, automation scripts, and write documentation. Additionally, you will work with architecture, logic design, and Design for testing (DFT) teams to fully implement cross-functional design requirements.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead effort for timing constraint creation and validation, timing analysis and timing Engineering Change Order (ECO) creation, and final timing sign-off for complex ASICs.
  • Drive both static timing analysis methodology development and support, as well as chip implementation and timing signoff execution.
  • Develop, support and execute implementation flows around industry-standard static timing and parasitic extraction tools.
  • Interface with the broader team to triage and resolve reported technical issues, escalating complex tool-related problems to Electronic Design Automation (EDA) vendors and deliver timely and effective solutions.
  • Lead collaboration with RTL design and DFT team for high quality integrations and timing constraints.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in static timing analysis (STA), including 5 years of experience in a technical leadership capacity.
  • Experience achieving full-chip timing convergence and authoring, reviewing, or validating timing constraints (e.g., Synopsys Design Constraints (SDC)).
  • Experience using tool command language (Tcl) commands for timing analysis, timing closure, parasitic extraction, noise glitch, or crosstalk.
  • Experience using electronic design automation (EDA) tools (e.g., PrimeTime, Tempus, Timevision, or STAR-RC).
  • Experience analyzing cross-chip clock distribution networks.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • 12 years of experience in the domain of static timing analysis and 5 years of experience in leading STA activities for SOC.
  • Experience leading physical design or STA flow/methodology to successful tape-outs and shipping silicon.
  • Experience analyzing data trends, semiconductor device physics, SPICE simulation, and full-chip static timing topics.
  • Exceptional track record of on-time STA sign-off and delivery within physical design execution cycles.
  • Drove full-chip timing convergence, timing constraint validation, and complex timing ECO implementation and sign-off.

title: Data Transformation Lead, Large Customer Sales, Agencies and Partners (English, Portuguese)

As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

title: Applied AI and ML Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Google's leadership team hand-picks thorny business challenges, and members of BizOps work in small teams to find solutions. As part of this team you fully immerse yourself in data collection, draw insight from analysis, and then zoom out to develop compelling, synthesized recommendations. Taking strategy one step further, you also persuasively communicate your recommendations to senior-level executives, roll-up your sleeves to help drive implementation and check back-in to see the impact of your recommendations.

At Google, data drives all of our decision-making. As part of the Finance Data and AI (DnA) team in the CFO organization, our focus is on building secure, scalable, and intelligent solutions that transform financial operations.
In this role, you will lead the technical strategy, design, and deployment of end-to-end AI/ML and Agentic solutions to transform legacy Finance processes into AI-native workflows. You will not just build models; you will design autonomous, self-correcting agentic systems that partner with Finance Googlers to drive unprecedented efficiency across Google's Finance organization. You will operate at the intersection of advanced ML and Agentic tools to design, develop and deploy large-scale solutions for various Finance processes like Accounting, Finance Operations, financial planning and analysis, etc.

Responsibilities

  • Build, prototype, and scale end-to-end AI agents. Collaborate with senior developers to build robust system architectures that prioritize reliability, usability, and auditability—ensuring clear human-in-the-loop interfaces for finance professionals.
  • Take prototypes from isolated testing environments to scaled production systems. Collaborate with senior developers to design and deploy high-availability model endpoints with robust health checks, error handling, retries, and fallback mechanisms.

Minimum qualifications:

Preferred qualifications:

  • Demonstrated expertise in developing and deploying AI or ML models and utilizing modern observability/monitoring tools to track performance, latency, model drift.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical architectures and probabilistic model behaviors.
  • Strong command of classical ML modeling (e.g., time-series forecasting, tree-based models) alongside modern LLM/Generative AI tooling.

title: Research Engineering Manager, Responsible Frontier AI Research, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
As a Research Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of Research and Software Engineers in our Responsible Frontier AI Research team. Your team will build the engineering foundations of DeepMind's Responsibility research portfolio. This includes automated platforms that discover, measure, and mitigate jailbreaks, and red-teaming tools used by subject-matter experts across DeepMind. It also includes defenses that help AI agents operate safely on the open web, and evaluations and tools that facilitate mitigations for severe harms, such as chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) risks and harmful manipulation, as part of our Frontier Safety Framework.

Because the responsible AI landscape shifts quickly, you will need to be a highly adaptable leader who can step into any of these research areas, build context fast, and direct engineering effort where it matters most. You will balance research experiments with robust, scalable infrastructure that other teams rely on. You will also combine technical leadership with hiring, developing, and retaining an exceptional team.

You will be joining a specialized Applied Research and Responsibility team within Google while closely partnering with teams across DeepMind, Research, Product, and Policy to identify and address key issues in responsible AI. Our work remains deeply integrated with DeepMind.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

  • Set and communicate priorities for multiple workstreams that support the broader responsibility organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams, and move engineering capacity between research projects as priorities change.
  • Set clear expectations with individuals, including tech leads, based on their level and role. Meet regularly to discuss performance and development, provide feedback and coaching, and hire and grow a high-performing team.
  • Develop the long-term technical goal and roadmap within, and often beyond, the scope of your teams, covering systems such as evaluation pipelines, red-teaming tools, autoraters, and mitigation training pipelines. Evolve it as frontier models become more capable, agentic, and multimodal.
  • Oversee system designs and review code to solve ambiguous problems. Set best practices for code quality, scalability, reliability, and secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Partner with Research Scientists, Subject-Matter Experts, and Product, Program, Policy, and Trust and Safety teams to turn research into evaluations and mitigations that inform model launch decisions. Present trade-offs and results to senior leadership.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience leading teams working on AI safety, security, or responsible AI research (e.g., adversarial robustness, red teaming, safety evaluations, or mitigation's for frontier models).
  • Experience with one or more of the following: automated red teaming or jailbreak discovery, LLM-based autoraters and evaluation design, safety classifiers or probes, prompt injection and agent security, or evaluation of severe-harm risks such as CBRN or Harmful Manipulation.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field with a focus on adversarial machine learning or AI/ML security.
  • Track record of research or engineering achievements, such as publications in peer-reviewed venues, open-source projects, or public benchmarks.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Fabric Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:

You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

On this team, expect to learn about how to scale systems to planet scale, work on agentic systems like Quicksilver, for scaling complex problem solving for a heterogeneous fleet, and understand how a long list of distributed systems work together to make Google's networks work. As a Engineering Manager, you will combine technical leadership and engineering management to oversee mission-critical cluster networks, control plane infrastructure, ML training networks, and next-generation fabric innovations.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

  • Experience with networking protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF), network architectures, or cloud networking services (e.g., VPCs, load balancers, firewalls).

title: Senior Software Engineer, D Management Layer
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

D is the foundational layer of Google’s storage stack. It is a low-level storage system that stores bytes directly to disk or flash and serves the majority of Google’s data. It is the critical mediation layer between higher-level storage systems and data center management facilities.

We're looking for engineers to help us build and scale this critical distributed control plane. You'll get to rethink how storage capacity is provisioned, isolated, and made available at Google scale.

This is an exciting time in the evolution of Google's core storage architecture, as we strive to maximize the utilization and efficiency of our storage resources fleetwide. By improving how we balance load, manage failure domains, and automate device lifecycles, you'll directly impact the reliability and cost-effectiveness of Google's global storage infrastructure.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

title: Kỹ sư quản lý chất lượng sản phẩm, Nhóm Sức khoẻ và Nhà ở
descriptionHtml:

Bạn sẽ đóng góp vào quá trình cải tiến để tạo ra những sản phẩm được hàng triệu người trên toàn thế giới yêu thích. Kiến thức chuyên môn của bạn sẽ góp phần định hình thế hệ trải nghiệm phần cứng tiếp theo, mang đến hiệu năng, hiệu suất và khả năng tích hợp vượt trội.

Nhóm Vận hành Sức khoẻ và Nhà ở cung cấp các sản phẩm phần cứng sáng tạo, hướng tới người tiêu dùng, được thiết kế để cải thiện sức khoẻ, thể chất và môi trường sống hằng ngày. Sứ mệnh của chúng tôi là gắn kết các phát kiến công nghệ đột phá với quy trình sản xuất hoàn hảo để xuất xưởng các sản phẩm chất lượng cao, từ đó mang lại trải nghiệm liền mạch cho khách hàng. Chúng tôi đảm bảo rằng mọi sản phẩm lưu thông trong chuỗi cung ứng của chúng tôi đều đáp ứng các yêu cầu nghiêm ngặt về chất lượng, độ an toàn và khả năng vận hành ổn định lâu dài.

Nhóm Nền tảng và Thiết bị phụ trách các nền tảng phần mềm điện toán khác nhau của Google trên nhiều môi trường (máy tính, thiết bị di động, ứng dụng), cũng như các thiết bị và dịch vụ do Google trực tiếp phát triển, kết hợp tối ưu AI, phần mềm và phần cứng của Google. Các nhóm trong lĩnh vực này nghiên cứu, thiết kế và phát triển các công nghệ mới nhằm giúp người dùng tương tác với công nghệ điện toán nhanh và liền mạch hơn, đồng thời mang đến trải nghiệm đột phá cho người dùng trên khắp thế giới.

Responsibilities

  • Xây dựng Kế hoạch kiểm soát chất lượng sản phẩm (PQCP) cho IQC, IPQC và OQC, đồng thời dẫn dắt các buổi đánh giá Phân tích dạng sai hỏng và ảnh hưởng của quy trình (PFMEA) cho các quy trình lắp ráp, kiểm thử và đóng gói thiết bị đeo.
  • Phối hợp với nhóm CMF và Thiết kế công nghiệp (IDE) về các mẫu chuẩn/giới hạn, giám sát FAI và thiết lập giao thức đo lường cho ECO.
  • Kiểm tra dây chuyền sản xuất tại nhà máy (SMT, FATP, ORT), giám sát các chỉ số Kiểm soát quy trình thống kê (SPC) và Cpk/Ppk, đồng thời thúc đẩy PFOL và Kiểm tra chất lượng thành phẩm xuất xưởng (OOBA).
  • Chủ trì các đợt điều tra nguyên nhân gốc rễ liên phòng ban (Tám nguyên tắc (8D), 5-Why, Fishbone) về sự cố ngừng dây chuyền, sụt giảm năng suất và sản phẩm lỗi do thị trường trả về.
  • Chủ trì các buổi đánh giá OK2x của Google (OK2Send, OK2Build, OK2Ship), hợp tác với nhà cung cấp về hoạt động Phân tích hệ thống đo lường (MSA)/Độ lặp lại và độ tái lặp của thiết bị đo (GR&R), đồng thời thực thi khả năng truy xuất nguồn gốc linh kiện.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân ngành Kỹ thuật điện, Kỹ thuật cơ khí, Kỹ thuật sản xuất, Kỹ thuật công nghiệp hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 5 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý chất lượng sản xuất trong ngành điện tử tiêu dùng.
  • Có kinh nghiệm về các quy trình và công cụ chất lượng như PFMEA, Kế hoạch kiểm soát, SPC và MSA/GR&R.
  • Có kinh nghiệm với các phương pháp giải quyết vấn đề (ví dụ: 8D, DMAIC, Fishbone, 5-Why, CAPA) cho các lỗi tại nhà máy và ngoài thị trường.
  • Có kinh nghiệm quản lý các nhà sản xuất theo hợp đồng (OEM/ODM/JDM) trên các dây chuyền Công nghệ dán bề mặt (SMT) cũng như Lắp ráp, Kiểm thử và Đóng gói hoàn thiện (FATP).
  • Có thể đi công tác nước ngoài đến 25% thời gian tới các cơ sở của đối tác sản xuất/nhà cung cấp trong các chu kỳ lắp ráp NPI quan trọng.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bằng Thạc sĩ ngành Kỹ thuật hoặc 5 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý chất lượng phần cứng cho các thiết bị đeo có cấu trúc phức tạp để theo dõi sức khoẻ hoặc thiết bị được kết nối.
  • Chứng chỉ Six Sigma Green Belt hoặc Black Belt.
  • Thành thạo các công cụ phân tích dữ liệu thống kê (Minitab, JMP) hoặc các công cụ theo dõi chỉ số tự động, phân tích Pareto về lỗi và báo cáo chất lượng.
  • Năng lực lãnh đạo kỹ thuật liên phòng ban xuất sắc, có khả năng tạo sự thống nhất về kỹ thuật giữa các nhóm thiết kế, vận hành và ban điều hành.

title: Customer Engineer, Platform, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.

You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, and data analytics.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $152000 - $221000 (USD) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
  • Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in-depth workshops.
  • Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
  • Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
  • Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
  • Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
  • Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
  • Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
  • Experience driving the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
  • Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
  • Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
  • Experience working with, and passion for, the startup ecosystem.
  • Experience building AI agents and tools and an understanding of their unique security implications.

title: ASIC Design Verification Engineer, Machine Learning
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

As an ASIC Design Verification Engineer, you will be part of a team developing ASICs used to accelerate computation in data centers. You will have dynamic, multi-faceted responsibilities in areas such as project definition, design verification and silicon bring-up.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $138000 - $197000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Plan the verification of complex digital design blocks by fully understanding the design specification and interacting with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios.
  • Create and enhance constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM, or formally verify designs with SVA and industry-leading formal tools.
  • Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner cases.
  • Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
  • Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience with design verification.
  • Experience with SystemVerilog/Verilog.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • 5 years of experience with industry standard tools, languages and methodologies relevant to the development of silicon-based ICs and chips.
  • Experience contributing across the entire design and verification life cycle.
  • Experience in verifying digital logic at RTL using SystemVerilog/UVM for ASICs.
  • Familiarity with ASIC standard interfaces and memory system architecture.
  • Strong problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

title: Technical Program Manager, Network Field Operations
descriptionHtml:

As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end regional network field execution across Hyperscale Data Centers, Carrier-Neutral Colocation Points of Presence, Core DWDM/Optical Transport sites, overseeing third-party vendor performance across high-density structured fiber builds, Layer 1–3 hardware installations, decommissioning, 24x7 break-fix dispatches.
  • Lead defined global program workstreams using structured program management artifacts - including project charters, Work Breakdown Structures, roadmaps, risk registers, communication plans - to standardize and elevate field execution.
  • Oversee vendor operational readiness, site ownership, service quality by conducting on-site technical field audits, validating optical and hardware standards, and enforcing Environmental Health and Safety compliance.

  • Collaborate with Capacity Delivery, Supply Chain, and other partner teams to improve processes.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in Technical Program Management.
  • Experience in Data Center Operations, Data Center Networking, Data Center Management, Network Infrastructure, Network Installation, Network Operations, Optical Networking, Optical Networking Equipment, Cabling, Structured Cabling, Fiber Optics, Dark Fiber, Lit Fiber, Fibers, Routers, Switches, Optical Time-Domain Reflectometer, Bit Error Rate Tester (BERT), Vendor Management.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in technical program management, leading end-to-end physical network infrastructure or core telecommunications build and operations programs using formal project charters, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), milestone roadmaps, and risk registers.
  • Experience with physical network field deployment, 24x7 maintenance in Hyperscale Data Center, Carrier-Neutral Colocation Point of Presence, Submarine Cable Landing Station, Core DWDM/OTN Optical Transport environments, including high-density Inside/Outside Plant (ISP/OSP) structured optical cabling (MPO/trunk fiber), rack/cabinet construction, AC/DC power systems, high-capacity Layer 1-3 routing and optical hardware installation.
  • Ability to travel up to 50% of the time as needed.

title: Senior Staff CPU Cache Subsystem Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

In this role, you will contribute to all phases of complex designs of CPU subsystems from design specification to productization, including integration into target SOCs.

You will lead a front-end design team, collaborate with members of architecture, software, verification, power, DFT, physical design teams to define the microarchitecture and schedule in delivering high quality RTL that meets project goals.

You'll help your team grow and solve technical problems with innovative micro-architecture and practical logic solutions. You will be responsible for evaluating and deciding on the best design options with complexity, performance, power and area and schedule in mind.

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. We aim to make people's lives better through technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $240000 - $333000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of digital design engineers working on CPU functional units, focusing specifically on microarchitecture and RTL design for next-generation CPU subsystems.
  • Review and propose performance-enhancing microarchitecture features while collaborating closely with cross-functional software, architecture, and performance teams on trade-off studies.
  • Deliver comprehensive plans to achieve project milestones and execution goals, ensuring the production-quality design meets strict scheduling targets.
  • Collaborate directly with verification, physical design, and power analysis teams to ensure designs successfully meet frequency, power, and area targets.
  • Direct load-store unit and cache subsystem design optimizations across CPU components to deliver power, performance, and area metrics.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15 years of experience in high-performance CPU design, including load-store unit logic/RTL and L2/L3 private/shared caches including microarchitecture definition and PPA optimizations.
  • Experience leading technical teams for modern processor subsystems with high speed, lower power design.
  • Experience with front-end quality checks (e.g., Lint, CDC/RDC).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with ARM instruction set architecture.
  • Experience with mobile CPU subsystem.
  • Experience with mobile SOC architecture/integration.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Geo Auto SDK Tech Lead
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a part of the Google Maps Automotive team, which is at the forefront of the automotive industry's rapid transformation to software-defined vehicles, we empower the world's leading car manufacturers to build next-generation navigation and infotainment systems by providing a highly customizable Software Development Kit (SDK) and a comprehensive suite of APIs as this brings the full power, scale, and innovation of Google Maps directly into the car. In this role, you will design and develop core components of the SDK, while also working closely with automotive partners to help them integrate our technology and shape the future of the in-vehicle experience.
The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $262000 - $364000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Set the multi-year technical direction and system architecture for the Geo Automotive SDK across map data delivery, localization, navigation, and 3D rendering.
  • Architect end-to-end software systems that connect cloud geospatial services and vehicle sensor pipelines to low-latency client APIs and multi-screen cockpit displays.
  • Define SDK design standards, testing and simulation strategies, and modular interfaces that allow the platform to scale cleanly across multiple vehicle programs.
  • Lead technical alignment across Geo service teams, Android Automotive, Product Management, and Forward Deployed Engineering to deliver cohesive capabilities for global automakers.
  • Shape the engineering culture across Seattle, Munich, and Mountain View by mentoring senior engineers and tech leads, raising the bar on code and design quality, and staying with complex technical problems.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 5 years of experience with design and architecture; and testing/launching software products.
  • Automotive industry experience.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 5 years of experience working across a matrixed organization involving multi-product integration or external partner ecosystems.
  • Experience with real-time 3D graphics rendering, geospatial navigation, localization, or ADAS and autonomous driving systems.
  • Experience architecting developer platforms, Software Development Kits (SDKs), or Android Automotive OS (AAOS) systems.

title: Manager, Emerging Market Policy Campaigns, Government Affairs and Public Policy (English, Portuguese)
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Communications and Public Affairs team, you will work cross-functionally to help communicate with journalists and other thought leaders; devise specific communications materials and campaigns; engage in face-to-face meetings with commentators and other opinion formers; and develop print and web-based material supporting these campaigns. We're looking for great communicators who can understand complex issues and explain them in person and also via well written, simple blog posts, FAQs, video scripts and more.

Google's Government Affairs and Public Policy team is looking for an exceptional political strategist and executor to run policy campaigns on the company's highest-priority issues in the Emerging Markets. You will drive outcomes on Google's top legislative priorities and most consequential regulatory issues, using sharp political acumen, operational, and creative goal to match the right tactics to the right moments. You will grow in ambiguity, pairs insight with execution, and is energized by piloting new tactics and building playbooks where none exist.

Responsibilities

  • Design and country-specific and regional campaigns to win on Google’s top legislative and regulatory priorities, defining and owning clear objectives and campaign plans of strategy, tactics, budgets, and cross-functional alignment.
  • Act as responsible for driving campaign execution for policy and regulatory-focused campaigns.
  • Work with advocacy groups, industry associations, third-party validators, and civic leaders to advocate forward-looking tech policy.
  • Commission research and develop proof points that strengthen policy positions with policymakers in coordination with our policy and product experts.
  • Direct agencies and partners to produce digital content, interactive tools, and events that advance campaign objectives.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience working on technology policy issues within government, think tanks, public interest groups, law, or relevant industry associations.
  • 10 years of experience working in public affairs, political communications, or political campaigns, or within government.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese fluently to engage with local stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Track record leading advocacy, marketing, or public awareness campaigns on tech policy issues.

title: Applied AI and Commercial Operations Specialist
descriptionHtml:
As a Cloud Infra & AI Agent Specialist, you will be at the forefront of integrating artificial intelligence into our core operational and analytical frameworks. You will own projects across four key pillars: Agentic tools engineering, demand forecasting, capacity planning, and performance management. You will embed yourself in the core operations of the business, identify the most impactful areas for AI tooling and automation, develop an implementation roadmap, and then execute. You will design custom agent frameworks, integrate them with GTM and capacity systems, and build workflow automation engines.

This role requires a blend of technical engineering and strategic business analysis to evaluate large datasets and systematize processes across the entire GTM organization and to do so leveraging AI tools and agents. You will work closely with leadership to provide actionable insights that influence multi-billion dollar infrastructure decisions, ensuring our supply of compute, storage, and AI chips perfectly aligns with customer demand and Gemini model usage.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $186000 - $269000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, build, and deploy custom Agentic solutions to streamline complex operations and manual regional workflows.
  • Partner with capacity planning to design, implement, and operate capacity allocations forums for Compute (CPU), Storage, and AI Chips (TPU/GPU), automating and scaling global signaling processes.
  • Evaluate, audit, and optimize complex cross-functional GTM systems by embedding autonomous intelligence models and feedback loops directly into core infrastructure decision-making.
  • Leverage first class machine learning and AI tools to automate demand forecasting. Use customer consumption & pipeline data to seize demand and make procurement decisions against those signals.
  • Build and scale robust performance management systems and database platforms to track revenue-based metrics across data center revenue, sales regions, and demand forecasting.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in data analysis.
  • Experience with Agentic programming or application development.
  • Experience in data analytics tools and languages, including advanced SQL, BigQuery, Looker, or similar.
  • Experience in cloud infrastructure, including IaaS compute, storage, and networking products.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a quantitative field such as Engineering, Statistics, Business, or Mathematics.
  • Experience building and deploying AI Agents or LLM-based applications in a production environment.
  • Deep understanding of data center capacity planning concepts, including AI chip types (GPU/TPU) and hardware-level metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to build consensus across teams and manage competing interests across senior stakeholders; presenting and leading executive reviews.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in an unstructured environment and bring clarity through structured platforms and automated systems.

title: Director, UK/I Devices Marketing
descriptionHtml:
As the Director of Devices and Services Marketing for the UK and Ireland (UKI), you will be responsible for defining and delivering the consumer and commercial marketing strategy across our hardware and services portfolio, including Pixel, Home & Health, and Gemini-powered features. You will drive brand love, consumer consideration, and commercial performance in one of Google’s most critical commercial markets.

In this role, you will lead end-to-end go-to-market execution, integrating brand activations with retail, carrier, and digital sales channels. You will partner closely with UKI Go-To-Market (GTM) leadership, regional EMEA marketing leadership, and global product teams to advocate for the voice of the UKI consumer to shape product launch strategies, including demand generation and demand capture to grow market share across key telco and retail partner ecosystems.

Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems--from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can--changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the integrated brand and commercial go-to-market strategy for Google’s Devices & Services portfolio (Pixel, Nest/Home, Health, and Gemini) across the UK & Ireland while elevating Pixel’s market positioning and full-funnel brand health to drive awareness, consideration, NPS, and premium perception.
  • Deliver impactful multi-channel campaigns and high-profile partnerships to inspire switchers and foster ecosystem loyalty.
  • Direct joint marketing and retail activations across third-party carriers, retailers, and the Google Store to ensure premium visibility and strong sell-through.
  • Represent Google in executive negotiations with key UKI commercial partners, aligning internal cross-functional stakeholders and agency partners to execute cohesive marketing programs.
  • Build, coach, and inspire an inclusive, high-performing team of brand and channel marketers.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15 years of experience in marketing, working across one or more marketing fields (i.e., growth, product marketing, brand marketing, social).
  • 10 years of experience with people management.
  • Experience managing and influencing teams across multiple products and interfacing with multiple internal/external constituencies (e.g., agencies, global marketing teams, country marketing teams, partners, product management).
  • Experience presenting to audiences of senior decision makers.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working in the carrier, retail or mobile device manufacturing industries with strong partnership skills.
  • Ability to represent an organization at the highest levels with customers, partners, events, and industry.
  • Experience in leading a high-performing team, who can influence global teams in a multi-billion dollar business, and a demonstrated ability in leading complex retail initiatives.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

title: Data Center Technician Intern, 2027
descriptionHtml:
Behind Google’s simple search box is one of the most complex technology infrastructures in the world and behind that infrastructure is a various group of Googlers, who design, build, and keep the lights on for our users. Our Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future, and our technicians, engineers, and support teams bring ideas to life. The teams use creative approaches to reduce operational costs and to extend traditional practices to meet our goal of making our data centers the most energy-efficient and environmentally sustainable in the world.

As a Data Center Technician Intern, you'll be a key part of the Data Center team, gaining experience by helping with the installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of hardware, including servers and their components, as well as server software like Google's Linux cluster. You'll learn how to configure and manage network components such as routers, hubs, bridges, and switches. Additionally, you will be involved in manual movement and rack installation of equipment and may even have the opportunity to participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations. This internship is a fantastic opportunity to build a solid foundation in data center operations and network infrastructure.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Netherlands: €40600 (EUR) + 0% bonus target

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Responsibilities and detailed projects will be determined based on your educational background, interest, and skills.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in an educational program relevant to the job qualifications or an accredited full-time Bachelor's or Master's degree program located in the EMEA region.
  • Relevant practical or internship experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting one of the following: operating systems, computer/server hardware, or networking protocols.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Relevant practical to internship experience performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a similar role (e.g. Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc).
  • Relevant practical to internship experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.

title: Junior CAD Engineer, University Graduate, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. As a CAD Engineer, you will drive the architecture, development, and optimization of hardware design flows and infrastructure. In this role, you will address complex hardware design technology challenges, streamline CAD workflows for high-impact silicon projects, and ensure high quality and scalability across global engineering teams.

The ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc.) and Google Cloud. Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world.

We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing. Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement CAD tools, solutions and methodologies for ASIC development.
  • Create software solutions that improve the hardware design process through automation.
  • Propose, design and implement software automation that directly addresses bottlenecks in today's ASIC and SoC EDA flow.
  • Leverage AI to both speed the development of tools and development flows, providing more natural and higher-efficiency ways for users to interact with developed technologies.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with hardware tools and flows.
  • Experience with scripting for automation (e.g., shell, Python).

Preferred qualifications:

  • 1 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, and with data structures and algorithms.
  • 1 year of experience building developer tools that improve developer velocity, code quality and code health (e.g., compilers, automated).

title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Safety and Security
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you will join a specialized research effort dedicated to proactive threat mitigation, adversarial machine learning, and agentic security. Our team operates at trustworthy AI, focusing on securing next-generation AI models and intelligent agents against emerging threats. You will focus on the machine learning foundations of AI safety, developing innovative techniques, continual learning, and interpretability to prevent safety drift and enhance intrinsic model robustness. You will co-develop advanced evaluation benchmarks, working alongside academic institutions and global engineering teams to provide research that will form the basis of next-generation trustworthy AI capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Drive foundational machine learning research in model robustness, continual learning, interpretability, and multiobjective optimization to advance trustworthy AI.
  • Design and develop rigorous evaluation protocols, scenario-based benchmarks, and stress-testing methodologies to assess frontier AI capabilities and multi-agent consensus.
  • Curate advanced datasets and conduct fine-tuning or optimization experiments to enhance model resilience against emerging threats and ensure adherence to safety constraints.
  • Collaborate extensively with regional engineering hubs, core product teams, and academic partners to transition theoretical proofs-of-concept into robust production solutions.
  • Publish groundbreaking research in machine learning venues and actively participate in academic and industry research communities.

Minimum qualifications:

  • PhD degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience leading a research agenda.
  • Experience in machine learning, adversarial machine learning or evaluating frontier AI systems, which includes but not limited to supervised learning, unsupervised learning and reinforcement learning, ML interpretability, adversarial robustness, ML safety, generative models, agentic AI, multi-object optimization.
  • One of more scientific publication submission(s) for conferences, journals, or public repositories (such as CVPR, ICCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with general purpose programming languages (e.g., Python).
  • Experience investigating emerging technical threats (e.g., automated scams, deepfake generation, or rogue agent vulnerabilities) and designing robust, proactive defense mechanisms.
  • Demonstrated expertise in adversarial machine learning, AI agent security, data poisoning, prompt injection, and model backdoor detection.
  • Strong background in applying a security mindset to artificial intelligence, including debugging complex ML failure modes, reverse engineering model behaviors, and red-teaming frontier AI systems.
  • First-authored publications in top machine learning, safety/security tracks in machine learning or AI conferences, or HCI conferences.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Application Specific Integrated Circuits Firmware
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a part of this team, you will develop C++ code that controls and monitors Google’s custom accelerators (ASICs), including TPUs (for machine learning) and VCUs (for video encode/decode). You will also define the API that the rest of the software stack uses to build planet-scale deployments of the systems that use these ASICs. You will write code that directly handles interrupts, DMAs, and many other hardware-centric features. You will have a direct role in the initial debug and bring-up of new ASICs and among the first teams to use the new chips. Additionally, our team owns simulation models that allow for early software development pre-silicon, work closely with external vendors and many internal teams including chip design, system software, ML supercomputer, compiler, and system test.The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Develop firmware responsible for handling features such as power-on and reset of the ASICs, initializing low level hardware, security, and virtualizing the ASIC to multiple processes and Virtual Machines (VMs).
  • Support trusted firmware, key management, and protect user data and privacy (i.e. confidential compute) using advanced security technologies.
  • Develop tools to update and debug ASIC firmware, while enabling chip bring-up and hardware debugging.
  • Collaborate closely with the hardware design and development teams on code design hardware/software interface.
  • Build functional and cycle-level simulators that bit-accurately model the custom accelerator ASICs, along with tools and infrastructure to help with ASIC design verification, tapeout, and bring-up, and develop embedded CPU simulators as part of the full system simulator.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 5 years of experience working with embedded operating systems.
  • 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
  • Experience in C, C++ and Embedded Systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with data structures/algorithms.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.
  • Experience in embedded C/C++, embedded software development, Hardware/Software code design at the chip-level, multi-threaded designs, machine learning and video encoding/decoding.

title: Partner Enablement Product Support Manager, gUP Platforms and Devices

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. title: Senior Silicon Design Verification Engineer, YouTube Video Accelerators
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As a part of the Design Verification (DV) role in the Argos IP team, you will ensure the functional correctness of custom video codec ASICs for YouTube by managing a specialized High-Level Synthesis (HLS) workflow that requires verification at both the C/C++ and RTL levels. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between algorithmic intent and hardware implementation, employing a hybrid strategy that includes C++ software testing, C/RTL co-simulation, and traditional SystemVerilog/ Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) testbenches to guarantee equivalence and compliance. Your role demands comprehensive ownership of the verification life-cycle, from architectural planning and mixed-abstraction debugging to final coverage closure, while continuously refining methodologies to handle the specific complexities of HLS-based silicon design.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead comprehensive verification strategies and signoff for complex blocks where the source is C/C++, taking full ownership of quality from HLS code to generated RTL.
  • Design and maintain advanced environments, including C/C++ GoogleTest for functional validation and SystemVerilog/UVM for RTL timing and system interactions.
  • Employ HLS-specific methods such as C/RTL co-simulation, formal equivalence verification, and transaction-level modeling to ensure hardware fidelity.
  • Drive complex bug hunting and coverage analysis across both C++ and RTL domains to ensure complete verification of the design transformation.
  • Partner with design teams to optimize C++ code for verifiability and mentor junior engineers on the nuances of HLS verification.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with Design Verification.
  • Experience with SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology (UVM).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
  • Practical experience with High-Level Synthesis tools (e.g., Catapult, Vivado, XLS) and strong C/C++ skills for developing HLS testbenches and models.
  • Expertise in video processing, image pipelines, or video compression standards such as AV1, AV2, or H.264.
  • Demonstrated ability to debug complex issues across C/C++ and RTL levels using industry-standard EDA tools like VCS, Xcelium, or Verdi.

title: Security Engineer II, Enterprise Detection Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

As a Security Engineer in Enterprise Detection, you will help secure Google's enterprise systems and users from human and agentic cyber threats. This includes corporate endpoints (macOS, Linux, ChromeOS), off-Google and 2P/3P entities (e.g., Aqs/Bets), and infrastructure powering internal AI services/agents. You will build affluencies in Google's detection engineering practices aimed at using AI and traditional strategies to scale/mature high-fidelity detections to identify external threat actors and insider threats before they cause harm. Working with guidance from senior teammates, you will solve well-defined problems—typically focused on individual components or tactical subtasks within larger projects—while collaborating effectively with incident response, enterprise security (IIP), and engineering partners. You are expected to reliably execute well defined/delegated project tasks, drive iterative improvements to existing detections and workflows (e.g., integrate automation, adapt to agentic components), and build strong foundational and intermediate expertise in agentic detection engineering, automation, and threat modeling.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $123000 - $174000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Support peers to plan and execute threat models and scope detection requirements for enterprise surfaces, focusing on high-risk areas such as Insider Exfiltration, Access Abuse, and Malicious Process Execution.
  • Support engineers to design and implement components of detection logic for systems involving multiple (2-3) interconnected components, ensuring comprehensive coverage across enterprise surfaces.
  • Assess security risks and justify detection strategies based on threat intelligence and risk models. Design and implement improvements to existing detections to reduce false positives and improve detection fidelity.
  • Participate in post-exercise analysis (e.g., Red Team, Purple Team) to identify detection gaps, document findings, and implement remediation detections.
  • Work with peers to propose and implement incremental improvements to detection engineering pipelines, testing frameworks and automation tooling.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 1 year of experience with security assessments or security design reviews or threat modeling.
  • 1 year of coding experience in one or more general purpose languages.
  • Experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience developing tools or automating workflows to improve security operations.
  • Experience with query languages (e.g., SQL, Logica) and detection rule formats (e.g., Yara-L, YARA, Sigma).
  • Some on-job or in-classroom experience in detection engineering, security operations (SOC), threat hunting, or incident response.
  • Knowledge of building and tuning detections on enterprise surfaces (macOS, Linux, Google Workspace/SaaS).
  • Knowledge of AI and agentic systems and concepts.
  • Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework and threat modeling methodologies.

title: Staff CPU Architecture and Performance Architect
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As a CPU architecture and performance architect, you'll be the key contributor to improve processor instruction set architecture, to develop innovative microarchitecture features, and to deliver Google’s advanced SoC products. You’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talents in system performance and software teams to plan and conduct application and benchmark performance analysis and to project their performance at various design phases. Leveraging your CPU-specific knowledge and leadership, you’ll be guiding junior CPU architects and working with engineers in power, thermal, security, physical design and other subsystem teams to determine the CPU subsystem configuration and features, and to support the integration of CPU subsystem into the SoCs.

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. We aim to make people's lives better through technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

  • Plan and evaluate CPU architecture features from both architecture and performance angles.
  • Develop a performance model for performance analysis and microarchitecture design study.
  • Drive performance correlation between the performance model and RTL implementation, including micro-benchmark development and pre-silicon performance correlation, and post-silicon performance analysis and debugging.
  • Collaborate with other teams, such as RTL design, design verification, and physical design, to develop a high performance and efficient CPU implementation.
  • Architect chips or chip-subsystems by analyzing data, writing specifications, coordinating, and negotiating with stakeholders, and creating solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience with CPU architecture and performance modeling.
  • Experience in performance modeling, performance analysis, and workload characterization.
